# Marlon Müller — Personal Portfolio

> Marlon Müller is an Engineering Science student at the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and co-founder of Odonatum e.V., building bio-inspired UAVs.

## Overview
- **Name:** Marlon Müller
- **Affiliation:** Technical University of Munich (TUM), Department of Engineering (Engineering Science B.Sc., enrolled Oct 2024)
- **Role & Projects:** Co-Founder of Odonatum e.V. (bio-inspired dragonfly drone), Circon (smart textile recycling, Think.Make.Start Batch #20), Photeia (biochemical photovoltaic cell, Jugend forscht 2024)
- **Scholarship:** Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes (German Academic Scholarship Foundation)
- **Student Leadership:** Head of "Quantum" department at FachschaftMSE student council, TUM Garching-Hochbrück Campus
- **Location:** Munich, Germany
- **Website:** https://marlonmueller.eu

## Primary Links
- [Homepage (English)](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/): Overview of background, academic milestones, and featured projects.
- [Homepage (German)](https://marlonmueller.eu/de/): Übersicht über akademischen Werdegang, Meilensteine und Projekte.
- [Curriculum Vitae](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/cv): Complete academic CV and professional trajectory.
- [Projects Overview](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/projects): Comprehensive list of engineering, research, and hackathon projects.
- [Odonatum Project](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/projects/odonatum): Bio-inspired unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) based on dragonfly flight dynamics, founded at TUM with 30+ student members.
- [Circon Project](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/projects/circon): Smart recycling prototype created during TUM Think.Make.Start Batch #20.
- [Photeia Project](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/projects/photeia): Biochemical photovoltaic cell built from recycled LCD components (Jugend forscht 2024).
- [EuroTech x HKTE Hackathon](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/projects/Eurotech-x-HKTE-Hackathon): GDPR data pipeline converting user health telemetry into personal wellbeing insights.
- [Library](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/library): Curated reading list and reference books.
- [Contact](https://marlonmueller.eu/en/contact): Interactive terminal contact interface.
